Run naming, superseding the earlier --run/--job naming steers. Jack Heart: "ii think --experiment to override the overall experiment name, but still enforicng hte -job-seed [but allowed to skip those if there is only one of either]", then "experiment/job/seed i would say?". So: a run's address is experiment/job/seed. Omit the job level when the experiment defines one job, the seed level when the job has one seed (hanabi.py: hanabi; sweep.py: sweep/wide/seed-1). The command line names only the experiment (--experiment, default the file stem); --job and --seed select what the file defines in Python; there is no --run or --name flag. --resume takes no name: it resumes the run the selection addresses. A changed --config under an existing experiment and job is refused naming the changed fields and suggesting --experiment (operator's choice). Same addressing in train, launch, continue, eval, status, logs. Historical runs stay readable under their stored names. Words in scratch/demo-hanabi.md.
